content.text: I've gone through the first nine screens and I have an answer: Psagot and the IBI 125 index fund. Taking one more quick look before I write it up.

I'd open an account at Psagot and buy the "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" fund. With the page's example of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, it says I'd have about **86,045 ₪** left after fees and tax. I'm fairly sure. What decided it is that the page puts this pair first, marks it "הזול", and every other pair ends with less.

**How it went:**
- **First screen:** the big heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד". ת"א-125 was already picked. The amount boxes said 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month. I didn't change them, because the task didn't give amounts. With my own 30,000 the result would be bigger, but I don't know by how much.
- **Second screen:** "הפקדתם 70,000 ₪", then the box "הבחירה שלכם · הזול" with 86,045 ₪ in it. The next pair over was 85,015 ₪. That clicked: I put in 70k and end with 86k. Honestly I thought 7% a year would give more than that, but it does say "בכסף של היום".
- **List of accounts:** Psagot is first with 86,045 ₪ and costs 1,049 ₪ over 10 years. Leumi, One Zero and the others cost 4,500 ₪ and up. Altshuler, Excellence and Meitav cost more than 23,000 ₪, which scared me. I've heard of Psagot, so I'm fine with it.
- **The fund:** IBI מחקה, דמי ניהול 0.1%. The other funds on the list, the תעודות סל from Tachlit, Harel, Kesem and IBI, each show −1,030 ₪ or more compared to it.
- **Further down:** a chart about what changes the result. I only read "12 שנים → 18,905 ₪ יותר", so waiting longer matters most. The last screen I looked at had a bar chart starting at 79,910 ₪ for Harel + Jerusalem, then +5,022 ₪ for moving to Psagot and +1,113 ₪ for the IBI fund. That matched, so I stopped there. I never opened screens 11–13.

**Didn't get:** "דמי משמרת", "נאמן 0.025%", "4A", "העמלות זו על זו", "קבועים / משתנים", "מחזיקה את המניות", and the gray box "לא בחשבון".

**What bothered me:**
- The minus numbers on the funds: −0.04% for "my" fund, and −0.37% to −0.54% for the others. I can't tell if that means the fund loses money. I skipped the explanation underneath ("מול המדד…").
- The small cost bar (5,555, with green, orange and yellow pieces) had colours I could only match by scrolling down to the legend. I guessed the big pink part was tax.
- The page doesn't say what the first thing to actually do is, like how to open the account.
